merge_json_files: merge all JSON files in a directory into a single output JSON file
run_merge_jsons: run the merge_jsons script to combine JSONL files from a specified path
merge_jsonl_with_progress: merge JSONL files with progress logging every 1024 files merged
review_merge_jsons: review the merge_jsons script that concatenates JSON files using glob and argparse
refactor_merge_jsons: refactor the merge_jsons script to add error handling for malformed JSON rows
